classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. Select the deepest justified category. Choose a specific leaf when it is supported; choose a parent when only that parent is supported and no particular child is justified. Parent choices mean parent-only support, not a competing broad label for a known leaf. Do not guess a child from price, merchant type or product frequency. Choose unidentifiable only when no supported parent or identifiable exclusion is justified. Choose out_of_scope for an identifiable item outside all supported parents. These are mutually exclusive output resolutions.

criteria.produce.fruit: Fresh fruit and vegetables, whole or minimally cut. Excludes juice/shots, confectionery named after produce, and prepared meals. A generic fruit/vegetable department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Fresh fruit including citrus; exact fruit variety need not be known. Excludes juice and confectionery.
criteria.produce.vegetables: Fresh fruit and vegetables, whole or minimally cut. Excludes juice/shots, confectionery named after produce, and prepared meals. A generic fruit/vegetable department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Fresh vegetables including roots; excludes vegetable drinks and prepared meals.
criteria.grains.bread_bakery: Bread, bakery products and uncooked cereal-based staples. Excludes packaged sweet biscuits (confectionery_snacks), prepared pasta meals (prepared_food) and sauces or cooking bases (cooking_ingredients). Leaf: Bread, rolls and pastries; excludes packaged sweet biscuits.
criteria.grains.dry_staples: Bread, bakery products and uncooked cereal-based staples. Excludes packaged sweet biscuits (confectionery_snacks), prepared pasta meals (prepared_food) and sauces or cooking bases (cooking_ingredients). Leaf: Uncooked rice, pasta and breakfast cereals; excludes prepared meals.
criteria.dairy_eggs.milk_cream: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. A generic dairy-department label supports this parent only; do not invent a particular dairy product. Leaf: Plain animal milk and cream; excludes plant drinks, culinary coconut milk and cooking fats.
criteria.dairy_eggs.yogurt_quark: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. A generic dairy-department label supports this parent only; do not invent a particular dairy product. Leaf: Yogurt and quark; excludes milk/cream and cheese.

criteria.dairy_eggs.eggs: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. criteria.meat_fish.meat_sausage: Meat, poultry, sausage, cold cuts, fish and seafood. Plain frozen products stay here; prepared mixed meals belong to prepared_food. Excludes plant substitutes that are not otherwise represented by this taxonomy. Leaf: Meat, poultry, sausage and cold cuts; excludes fish and prepared mixed meals.

criteria.confectionery_snacks.confectionery: Confectionery, packaged sweet biscuits and savory snacks. Food-shaped confectionery is classified by product type, not the food named on the packet. criteria.confectionery_snacks.sweet_biscuits: Confectionery, packaged sweet biscuits and savory snacks. Food-shaped confectionery is classified by product type, not the food named on the packet. Leaf: Explicit deposit line with a positive charge; excludes the underlying beverage or container merchandise.

criteria.unidentifiable: The available raw_text, price and merchant_type do not justify any supported parent or an identifiable item outside the taxonomy. Opaque article numbers and unspecified miscellaneous/promotion lines belong here. Do not infer an identity from price or merchant type alone. If a parent is justified but its leaf is unknown, choose that parent instead. Do not use this for a clearly identifiable item outside the supported categories.
criteria.out_of_scope: The item or adjustment is identifiable, but no supported parent applies; for example an electronic cable, clothing or an ordinary merchandise-return adjustment. This asserts known exclusion, not missing information. If a supported parent is justified, choose it even when no leaf is known. If the item itself cannot be identified enough to establish exclusion, choose unidentifiable instead.
